The original plan placed the start of the municipal pilot on 15 September 2026. Incomplete mappings and the lack of confirmation concerning the registration-data licence make that date unlikely to remain feasible. A working date of 13 October is proposed, with two preceding weeks for loading, testing, and corrections.

The 13 October date is provisional. It must not be presented as agreed with the Santa Marina City Council or replace the date in the approved plan yet. The steering committee must review the effect on deliverable D3, environment availability, and municipal staff participation. Formal confirmation by email will then be required.

Javier will update a draft schedule, but the published version will continue to show 15 September until an approved decision exists. The main risk is that mapping validation may continue beyond August.
